arguments.sql_query: SELECT TOP 30 c.concept_id, c.concept_name, c.vocabulary_id, COUNT_BIG(*) AS n, SUM(CASE WHEN m.value_as_number IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS n_numeric, SUM(CASE WHEN m.range_high IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS n_range_high FROM omop.measurement m JOIN omop.concept c ON c.concept_id=m.measurement_concept_id WHERE LOWER(c.concept_name) LIKE '%d-dimer%' OR LOWER(c.concept_name) LIKE '%d dimer%' OR LOWER(c.concept_name) LIKE '%fibrin d-dimer%' GROUP BY c.concept_id,c.concept_name,c.vocabulary_id ORDER BY n DESC

SELECT TOP 40 c.concept_id, c.concept_name, c.vocabulary_id, COUNT_BIG(*) AS n FROM omop.procedure_occurrence p JOIN omop.concept c ON c.concept_id=p.procedure_concept_id WHERE LOWER(c.concept_name) LIKE '%pulmonary embol%' OR LOWER(c.concept_name) LIKE '%ct angiography of chest%' OR LOWER(c.concept_name) LIKE '%computed tomography pulmonary%' OR LOWER(c.concept_name) LIKE '%ventilation%perfusion%' OR LOWER(c.concept_name) LIKE '%v/q%' GROUP BY c.concept_id,c.concept_name,c.vocabulary_id ORDER BY n DESC

SELECT TOP 40 c.concept_id, c.concept_name, c.vocabulary_id, COUNT_BIG(*) AS n FROM omop.condition_occurrence co JOIN omop.concept c ON c.concept_id=co.condition_concept_id WHERE c.domain_id='Condition' AND (LOWER(c.concept_name) LIKE '%pulmonary embol%' OR c.concept_id IN (440417,45768439)) GROUP BY c.concept_id,c.concept_name,c.vocabulary_id ORDER BY n DESC

content.text: The failures show the prior-year comorbidity scan over `condition_era` is too large for the read-only query deadline; my assumption that it would be indexable enough was wrong. I’ll switch to a bounded, different approach: clusters from diagnoses/symptoms attached to the suspected-PE index visit only, which avoids the expensive person-level lookback.

arguments.sql_query:
WITH d AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT visit_occurrence_id FROM omop.measurement
  WHERE visit_occurrence_id IS NOT NULL AND measurement_concept_id IN (4015482,3051714,3048530,4322628,42709958,2212698)
), img AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT visit_occurrence_id FROM omop.procedure_occurrence
  WHERE visit_occurrence_id IS NOT NULL AND procedure_concept_id IN (42742555,2212011,3572799,36713226,36715390,21492106,43055216,3038858,3038661,3035871,3037092,44798684,3529915,3040857,4175357,40338992,40308569)
), obs AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT visit_occurrence_id FROM omop.observation
  WHERE visit_occurrence_id IS NOT NULL AND observation_concept_id = 4220464
), suspected0 AS (
  SELECT visit_occurrence_id FROM d UNION SELECT visit_occurrence_id FROM img UNION SELECT visit_occurrence_id FROM obs
), suspected AS (
  SELECT s.visit_occurrence_id, v.person_id, v.visit_start_date
  FROM suspected0 s JOIN omop.visit_occurrence v ON v.visit_occurrence_id=s.visit_occurrence_id
), base AS (
  SELECT s.visit_occurrence_id, s.person_id, s.visit_start_date,
         CASE WHEN EXISTS (
           SELECT 1 FROM omop.condition_occurrence co
           JOIN omop.concept_ancestor ca ON ca.descendant_concept_id=co.condition_concept_id AND ca.ancestor_concept_id=440417
           WHERE co.person_id=s.person_id AND co.condition_start_date>=s.visit_start_date AND co.condition_start_date<DATEADD(day,8,s.visit_start_date)
         ) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS pe7
  FROM suspected s
), flags AS (
  SELECT b.visit_occurrence_id, b.pe7,
    MAX(CASE WHEN ca.ancestor_concept_id=77670 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS chest_pain,
    MAX(CASE WHEN ca.ancestor_concept_id=312437 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS dyspnea,
    MAX(CASE WHEN ca.ancestor_concept_id IN (444070,4007310) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS tachycardia,
    MAX(CASE WHEN ca.ancestor_concept_id=135360 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS syncope,
    MAX(CASE WHEN ca.ancestor_concept_id=4133004 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS dvt,
    MAX(CASE WHEN ca.ancestor_concept_id=443392 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS cancer,
    MAX(CASE WHEN ca.ancestor_concept_id=4125650 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS thrombophilia,
    MAX(CASE WHEN ca.ancestor_concept_id=316139 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS heart_failure,
    MAX(CASE WHEN ca.ancestor_concept_id=255573 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS copd,
    MAX(CASE WHEN ca.ancestor_concept_id=313217 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS afib,
    MAX(CASE WHEN co.condition_concept_id IN (40348673,40523075) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS hemoptysis
  FROM base b
  LEFT JOIN omop.condition_occurrence co ON co.visit_occurrence_id=b.visit_occurrence_id
  LEFT JOIN omop.concept_ancestor ca ON ca.descendant_concept_id=co.condition_concept_id AND ca.ancestor_concept_id IN (77670,312437,444070,4007310,135360,4133004,443392,4125650,316139,255573,313217)
  GROUP BY b.visit_occurrence_id,b.pe7
), clusters AS (
  SELECT pe7,
    CONCAT(
      CASE WHEN tachycardia=1 THEN 'tachycardia+' ELSE '' END,
      CASE WHEN dyspnea=1 THEN 'dyspnea+' ELSE '' END,
      CASE WHEN dvt=1 THEN 'DVT+' ELSE '' END,
      CASE WHEN cancer=1 THEN 'cancer+' ELSE '' END,
      CASE WHEN thrombophilia=1 THEN 'thrombophilia+' ELSE '' END,
      CASE WHEN heart_failure=1 THEN 'HF+' ELSE '' END,
      CASE WHEN copd=1 THEN 'COPD+' ELSE '' END,
      CASE WHEN afib=1 THEN 'AF+' ELSE '' END,
      CASE WHEN hemoptysis=1 THEN 'hemoptysis+' ELSE '' END,
      CASE WHEN chest_pain=1 THEN 'chest pain+' ELSE '' END,
      CASE WHEN syncope=1 THEN 'syncope+' ELSE '' END
    ) AS cluster
  FROM flags
), totals AS (SELECT COUNT_BIG(*) n, SUM(pe7) pe FROM flags), agg AS (
  SELECT CASE WHEN cluster='' THEN 'none of selected features' ELSE LEFT(cluster,LEN(cluster)-1) END AS cluster,
         COUNT_BIG(*) AS n, SUM(pe7) AS pe
  FROM clusters GROUP BY CASE WHEN cluster='' THEN 'none of selected features' ELSE LEFT(cluster,LEN(cluster)-1) END
)
SELECT TOP 15 cluster, n AS exposed_n, pe AS confirmed_pe_7d,
       CAST(100.0*pe/n AS decimal(6,2)) AS pe7_pct,
       CAST(((pe+0.5)/(n-pe+0.5))/(((t.pe-pe)+0.5)/(t.n-t.pe-n+pe+0.5)) AS decimal(10,2)) AS odds_ratio
FROM agg CROSS JOIN totals t
WHERE n >= 100
ORDER BY odds_ratio DESC, confirmed_pe_7d DESC;

content.text:
Operational cohort: OMOP visits with PE workup evidence (D-dimer, PE imaging/VQ/CTPA, or “suspected PE” observation). Confirmed PE = pulmonary embolism descendant diagnosis within 7 days.

## D-dimer / PE yield

| Metric | Count | % |
|---|---:|---:|
| Suspected PE encounters | 89,934 | — |
| D-dimer ordered | 84,169 | 93.59% |
| D-dimer with numeric result | 37,555 | 44.62% of ordered |
| D-dimer positive | 26,748 | 31.78% of ordered; 71.22% of numeric |
| Confirmed PE within 7 days | 4,466 | 4.97% |

Note: “positive among ordered” is diluted by order/CPT-only D-dimer records without numeric values. “Positive among numeric” is the more interpretable lab-result rate.

## Index-visit symptom associations with 7-day PE

| Feature | Encounters | PE within 7d | PE % | OR |
|---|---:|---:|---:|---:|
| Tachycardia | 10,805 | 834 | 7.72% | 1.74 |
| Dyspnea | 18,976 | 1,172 | 6.18% | 1.35 |
| Syncope | 2,655 | 130 | 4.90% | 0.99 |
| Chest pain | 25,171 | 962 | 3.82% | 0.69 |

## Interpretation

- The strongest completed associations were **tachycardia** and **dyspnea** at the index encounter.
- **Syncope** was roughly neutral.
- **Chest pain alone** was less associated with confirmed PE than the overall suspected-PE cohort, likely reflecting broad PE rule-out testing in chest-pain presentations.
- Prior-year comorbidity and combined symptom/comorbidity cluster queries repeatedly timed out on the read-only EHR backend, so I would not report comorbidity clusters from this run without materializing the suspected-PE cohort first.
